title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy Steps Down After 11 Years!
summary: Flipkart announced that Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down on December 4, 2026, after more than 11 years with the company, with CPTO Balaji Thiagarajan stepping in as interim leader. The exit comes amid reported tensions with Walmart over IPO timing, profitability, and ESOP liquidity following Flipkart's return to India domicile.
raw_text: So check this out if you follow Indian tech and startup leadership moves: Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is stepping down on December 4 after more than 11 years with the company. Here's the wild part—Chief Product and Technology Officer Balaji Thiagarajan is taking over day-to-day operations in the interim while Walmart and the board look for a permanent successor. Honestly, this is huge for India's e-commerce and quick-commerce ecosystem, especially with Flipkart Minutes scaling rapidly and reports pointing to friction over IPO timelines, profitability, and ESOP liquidity. I think putting a tech and product leader like Thiagarajan in the interim seat shows how much weight engineering, AI, and quick commerce carry right now. Let's see who gets the permanent job and what happens next with Flipkart's listing plans.

title: David Fincher Used AI to 'Re-Lip' Most of His New Movie?!

Specific AI tools and shot counts have not yet been publicly disclosed.

title: CoT-Proxy Boosts a Tiny 4B Coding Model From 2.7% to 27.8%!
summary: A new preprint on CoT-Proxy distillation shows that training the compact Qwen3-4B model on a teacher model's actions and concise reasoning summaries lifted its SWE-bench Verified score from 2.7% to 27.8% in a single run. The results come from a single unrefereed benchmark run using GPT-5.6 Luna as the teacher.
raw_text: So check this out if you build with smaller models or local AI setups: a preprint on CoT-Proxy distillation just showed a compact 4-billion-parameter Qwen3-4B model jumping from 2.7% to 27.8% on SWE-bench Verified! Here's the wild part—instead of needing raw hidden chains of thought, it uses observable actions and short reasoning summaries from GPT-5.6 Luna as an extra training target. Honestly, this is huge if those gains hold up consistently on real-world coding tasks, because running tiny models locally is way cheaper and faster. I am keeping a healthy dose of caution since this comes from a single preprint run without peer review yet. Still, getting a 10x leap out of a 4B model is seriously eye-catching.

title: OpenAI Tests Private Inference Alpha as GPT-6.2 Limits Tighten!
summary: OpenAI confirmed an alpha for Private Inference using confidential computing and verifiable in-flight controls for select customers, while fixing a launch under-counting bug on GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol. Fixing the metering bug caused Astra and Sol limits to hit 40% and 25% faster, with one banked reset granted and no back-charges.

title: Sakana AI Drops Marlin 2.0 Research Modes With 300 Credits & Slides!

title: New Tools Push 66GB AI Models on a 24GB GPU & Speed Up IDE Agents!
summary: Developer updates highlighted the MIT-licensed agy-fast Antigravity plugin with five batching tools aimed at cutting LLM turns, alongside Magnitude and Epochal Time Portal for SSD-offloaded local execution and archived-web agent testing. A 66 GB model was demonstrated running on a 24 GB RTX 3090 with company-reported 41 tokens per second throughput.
raw_text: Honestly, this is huge if you love squeezing max performance out of local hardware and coding agents! We saw agy-fast pop up as an MIT-licensed local MCP plugin for Antigravity with five batching tools to trim back-and-forth LLM turns, plus Magnitude and Epochal Time Portal for SSD offloading and archived-web agent testing. So check this out—running a 66 GB model on a 24 GB RTX 3090 via SSD offloading at a reported 41 tokens per second sounds wild on paper! Here's the wild part: both the 33.7% turn reduction and the 41 tokens/sec speed come from small self-reported tests, so real-world mileage will vary. Still, seeing local tooling push past VRAM limits and cut agent chatter is super exciting for tinkerers.
